style: Grounded, desaturated cinematic realism, heavy film grain, no stylised colour pop, no lens flare, practical haze. Concrete, fluorescent tubes, CRT-era hardware, salvaged tools (bible Part III, Practical result); the arcology's glass and steel monoliths on concrete plinths (Part III, Architecture). Colour carries plot (Part VI, Dr. Tox section 6): cold desaturated gray-teal world (#5E7375, #8A9A99), amber and warm gold for the cage and control (#D99A2B, #F2C14E), sickly luminous green only for the toxin unbound (#7FD957), black and near-black red for his blood (#1A0B0C, #4A0F14), clinical white for the suite and the hub's plant light (#E9ECEA); hard-light pale gold for Aegis's panes (#F6E7B8). Amber and green never share a frame at equal weight. No chrome, no gloss, no neon, no characters, no text other than the stamped letters RCC where named.
